Working from the article content directly. Here is the full analysis:

---

**Published online:**
2026-09-03

**Geographic focus:**
United States (with secondary reference to Middle East — Iran/Israel)

**Temporal focus:**
T1. Historical report [YES] — recaps Wednesday gold/dollar moves
T2. Forward-looking reporting short-term risks (next few weeks/months) [YES] — NFP Friday, CPI/PPI next week, Sep 15–16 Fed meeting
T3. Forward-looking reporting long-term risks (next quarters/years) [NO]

**Synopsis:**
Gold surged 2.3% spot / 2.8% futures as Fed Governor Waller signaled openness to holding rates steady if inflation continues to cool. This softened rate-hike odds for the Sep 15–16 FOMC meeting from ~62% to ~54%. Falling Treasury yields and a weaker dollar amplified gold's rally. Silver, platinum, and palladium also posted strong gains. Oil rose for a fourth straight session on Middle East supply disruption fears (US strikes on Iran, Israeli threats on Tehran). Key near-term catalyst: Friday's NFP print, followed by August CPI/PPI next week.
